digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync command and reconcile request routing
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass, without invoking or duplicating reconcile-check.
Canonical preview must be lock-free: it acquires, purges, steals, and writes no pass lock, leaving unrelated repository/ref state byte-identical.
Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and exit behavior unchanged.

Argparse must set allow_abbrev=False so that undocumented prefix abbreviations and unknown options exit with invocation error 2 before any store access, locks, or mutation, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live retains a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE through CLI/library/MCP/workflows retains historical tally/no-manifest behavior.
Legacy capped canonical sync and bootstrap applied/deferred partitions, and the route-level normalized-request disposition threading through run_pass and reconcile_once, remain unchanged.
